description:
What breaks if you change a function, file or module.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• You're about to change a signature, refactor or delete code
• You need every caller, including indirect ones, or the endpoints a change reaches

RETURNS: Risk level, callers up to 5 hops away by module and file, and the endpoints, cron jobs and DB operations they reach.

USE INSTEAD OF: grepping for the name and following callers by hand. Grep finds direct references only; it misses callers 2-3 hops away and the entry points they reach.

depth.description: How many hops to trace (default: 3, max: 5)

entity.description: Function name, file path, or module name

repo.description: Repository name — one of your connected repos.

name: get_blast_radius
